            float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value)
            if self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            else None
        )

        spy_buy = (
            spy_sma_200_ready
            and old_spy_sma_200 <= (
                float(self.spy_closes[-2])
                if len(self.spy_closes) >= 2
                else spy_close
            )
            and spy_close > current_spy_sma_200
        )

        spy_sell = (
            self.spy_lot > 0
            and spy_sma_50_ready
            and old_spy_sma_50 >= (
                float(self.spy_closes[-2])
                if len(self.spy_closes) >= 2
                else spy_close
            )
            and spy_close < current_spy_sma_50
        )

        aapl_buy = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3

        aapl_sell = (
            self.aapl_lot > 0
            and aapl_rsi_ready
            and current_aapl_rsi > 60
        )

        if spy_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if aapl_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_buy:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and aapl_buy:
            available_cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)

            if available_cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity
